fusions.name: Drumming Hooves
fusions.desc: Drums the water around you, dealing 7 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles. It holds 3 charges, and kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Long-Ridden Charge
fusions.desc: A strike that always lands as a critical hit, dealing 30 damage and leaving the target [Bruised] for 3 damage a second for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: The Long Haul
fusions.desc: Increases your stamina recovery by 50% for 15 seconds.

fusions.name: Tireless Swim
fusions.desc: When you spend stamina, you regain 2 stamina a second for 4 seconds. Once every 12 seconds.
